name: run_survival_analysis
description: Run Kaplan-Meier survival analysis and log-rank test using R's survival package. Generates a KM curve plot and survival summary.

parameters.data_path: string — path to survival data CSV (columns: time, event 0/1, group)
parameters.time_col: string — column name for survival time (default 'time')
parameters.event_col: string — column name for event indicator 1=occurred 0=censored (default 'event')

returns: dict with log-rank p-value, output_files (kaplan_meier.png, survival_summary.csv)
